name: ui-layouts-globe
blurb: 3D rotating globe with customizable colors, scale, and lighting.
description: A WebGL-rendered 3D globe using the cobe library with responsive canvas sizing. Highly customizable via color (base, markers, glow), lighting (dark, diffuse), scale, and map sampling parameters.
use_when: Landing pages, analytics dashboards, or global company pages with customizable 3D globe visualization.
avoid_when: Low-end devices without WebGL support. Static globe only; no pointer interaction or manual rotation.
a11y: Canvas-based globe with no built-in accessibility; serves as visual decoration only.
